$comment: The whole documentation, page by page: what each page covers and where its facts live in the repository. A page with a file content/docs/<slug>.md is written and in the navigation; the rest are planned, listed on /docs/outline/. Every source path is checked to exist by test/site.test.ts. A source is a repository path, optionally followed by a space and the section it means.
